name: Dutch heavy vehicle tax (belasting zware motorrijtuigen, Eurovignette)
vehicles: Goods motor vehicles whose maximum mass, alone or with the trailer, is 12,000 kg or more
law: Wet belasting zware motorrijtuigen, art. 10 (as in force on 1 January 2024, unchanged until 25 March 2025): the tax for a day is € 12 for every vehicle. Replaced on 25 March 2025 by the amounts by CO2 class.

sources.title: Wet belasting zware motorrijtuigen, in force on 2024-01-01 (wetten.overheid.nl)
Eurovignetten portal, user description: validity from 0:00 on the first day to 24:00 on the last
